mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_model_call_log (user_id, session_id, message_id, request_id, provider, model, status, http_status, token_in, token_out, latency_ms, first_token_ms, retry_count, error_code, error_msg) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{requestId}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{status}, #{httpStatus}, #{tokenIn}, #{tokenOut}, #{latencyMs}, #{firstTokenMs}, #{retryCount}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMsg})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(token_in, 0) + COALESCE(token_out, 0)), 0) AS totalTokens FROM chat_model_call_log

SELECT l.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.username, 'unknown') AS username, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(l.token_in, 0) + COALESCE(l.token_out, 0)), 0) AS tokens FROM chat_model_call_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id GROUP BY l.user_id, u.username ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(token_in, 0) + COALESCE(token_out, 0)), 0) AS tokens FROM chat_model_call_log WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC
